entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I ordered a jersey and I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the whole process on the website. I don't know what to do.

I can definitely help you with that. Not to worry. So I can understand the situation, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, um, a preference, I guess? I think I ordered the wrong size. It feels way too tight, and I just don't think I can wear it. I wanted to get an exchange for a bigger one. Can't you just help me? I find this all very overwhelming.

Of course, I can absolutely help you with that. It sounds like a simple size exchange is what you need. Let me just pull up your account... Okay, I see your order for the Aero Race Jersey. It looks like it was delivered about 10 days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. Is that a problem? I saw so many different policies, I got worried.
Not a problem at all. That particular jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy, so you are well within the timeframe for an exchange. We can get this sorted out for you right now.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. So I can get a new one?

Yes. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. To make this easier for you, I'll process the exchange with complimentary expedited shipping for the new size. We'll get that new, more comfortable jersey out to you right away. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label for the one that's too tight as we speak.
Wow, really? Expedited shipping? Thank you so much, Diana! You've made this so simple. I really appreciate it.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
